headline: UAH concede once in three wins
dek: UAH have let in one goal in three matches and scored ten, and the win at Georgia Southwestern was their second away from home. AUM and Trevecca are unbeaten too, and the three have won all nine matches they have played between them; no other programme has won more than once.
displaced_by: UAH's win at Georgia Southwestern made 'eight from eight' stale, the trio now nine from nine; the lede moves to UAH's defence, beaten once all season.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's ten goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: UAH have scored more goals than Christian Brothers, Delta State, Union, Lee and Spring Hill have between them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont, and no final has been left without a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee have no match on the record before conference play opens, played or still to come: the first listed for them is the conference visit to AUM.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every published result now has its detail behind it: the box scores missing from Mississippi Christian's matches a day ago have been filled.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Alabama have conceded eight goals, more than any other programme has let in.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has kept clean sheets in two of Trevecca's three matches.

last_match.line: A second win away from home for UAH, whose defence has been beaten once all season.

next_match.line: Christian Brothers have lost both matches they have played; Delta State have already won at Harding.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
